notes: LOOMING. Intro: the whip winds back (held), cracks forward over the berries, rebounds and settles; only the tail moves. The berries are black with plum drupelet beads and white glints; the leaves are the only index-2 green. Sport: 'Fall Gold'. Rubus 'Fall Gold' (University of New Hampshire, 1967): golden-amber fruit on yellow-green canes (indexes 1-2 only).
